```python
import pandas as pd
import seaborn as sns
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

# Load the dataset
data = pd.read_csv('data/credit_fraud.csv')

# Set the style of seaborn
sns.set(style="whitegrid")

# Create a count plot of transaction types colored by fraud status
plt.figure(figsize=(12, 6))
sns.countplot(data=data, x='transaction_type', hue='is_fraud', palette='Set1')

# Adding labels and title
plt.title('Transaction Types by Fraud Status', fontsize=16)
plt.xlabel('Transaction Type', fontsize=14)
plt.ylabel('Count', fontsize=14)
plt.legend(title='Is Fraud', loc='upper right', labels=['No', 'Yes'])

# Save the figure
plt.savefig('output.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150)
```
